FIELDS.NAME: Shutter & Lens Photography Studio
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Inspection contact for Shutter & Lens Photography Studio: Susan Miller, Studio Manager, susan.miller@shutterlens.com, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Shutter & Lens Photography Studio, we specialize in high-quality photography services, focusing on portrait, event, and commercial photography. Our operations are centered around a dedicated studio space equipped with standard photography equipment, ensuring a professional environment for our clients. We emphasize client satisfaction through structured booking and project management processes. While we occasionally offer ancillary services such as makeup and hairstyling, these remain secondary to our primary focus on photography. All our practices adhere to local business, zoning, and health and safety regulations, maintaining an inventory value not exceeding $500,000. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional photography while minimizing exposure to operational risks.

Our photography studio regularly maintains a diverse inventory of equipment and supplies, which we continually update and expand to ensure we are prepared for a wide range of client needs, often resulting in a total inventory value that exceeds $500,000.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Inventory loss due to accidental damage of photographic equipment during a client shoot on 07/12/2023, amounting to $4,000; currently in negotiation with the supplier for replacement options.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchpersons for enhanced protection.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any of its operations. The studio's focus remains solely on providing photography services without engaging in any activities that would include hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not sponsor athletic teams as our primary focus is on providing photography services. We do not engage in sponsorship activities that fall outside of our business operations.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are checked by the studio manager to ensure compliance with our insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related activities in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the last three years. The studio has maintained insurance continuity and compliance with its operational requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not lease employees to or from other employers; the studio employs its staff directly to ensure a consistent quality of service and operational control.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not currently carry Workers Compensation insurance, as all employees are directly accounted for under other liability provisions.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – I also operate "Photography by the River - Custom Portraits and Events." However, please note that our total inventory value does not exceed $500,000.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. All operations are focused on photography services in compliance with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products as our operations focus solely on providing photography services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations focus solely on providing photography services. This helps us maintain a manageable risk profile aligned with our business objectives.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus exclusively on providing photography services without engaging in hazardous material activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The total inventory value at Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not exceed $500,000, which is within the acceptable limit. Therefore, there is no catastrophe exposure related to inventory value.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The studio maintains a strong commitment to compliance and risk management within its operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Shutter & Lens Photography Studio does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. All operations comply with local business, zoning, and health and safety regulations.
